findings.message: Authorization logic is inverted: the middleware now rejects admin users with 403 and lets non-admin authenticated users through (next()). This defeats requireAdmin entirely — any authenticated non-admin can access admin routes while actual admins are blocked.
findings.suggestion: Restore the negated condition: if (!user.isAdmin) { res.status(403)... return; } then next().

findings.message: The hunk adds a second `export function isAdminUser(...)` while an identical definition already exists in the file (shown in the enclosing context and symbol definitions at line 49). This produces a duplicate exported identifier / duplicate function implementation and will fail compilation.
findings.suggestion: Remove the newly added duplicate `isAdminUser` block from the diff; keep the existing single definition.
